note: Round 3 of the FID loop (user, 2026-10-10): the baseline is the final checkpoint of the 200,000-step run with self-flow teaching (averaged teacher) and self-teaching (output term, z after block 3). Its config is the base: cost 1 = one step of that recipe. A node trains base_steps / cost steps. change = patch of the job config. pass = next node if the FID beats the reference by more than the margin (the change is kept), fail = next node if not. follower_only = runs only when another node names it. No node adds a model parameter.

b_small_crop.why: Crops of 0.1 to 0.5 of the side for the judge (about 1 FID better on the old baseline, twice)

b_tiny_crop.why: Crops of 0.05 to 0.3 of the side, after the small crops gained

b_teach_noisy.why: The self-flow teaching term counts only the noisier patches (JEPA: predict the masked part)

b_teacher_slow.why: Slower averaged teacher: decay 0.9999 in place of 0.999

b_flow_w2.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 2 (115.39 against 116.91 on the old baseline)

b_flow_w4.why: Self-flow teaching term at weight 4 (114.38 on the old baseline)

b_share40.why: 40% of the student patches at the higher noise level in place of 25%

b_out_w2.why: Output term of self-teaching at weight 2: the judge of this baseline was trained with the term from the start

b_out_half.why: Output term at weight 0.5, after weight 2 failed

b_z6.why: Judge at block 6 in place of block 3 (level on the old baseline, a longer step)
